title: Sr Brand Manager Scotch Portfolio (Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas pretas e pardas)
description:
Job Description :

WE'RE DIAGEO. The beverage alcohol global industry leader and home to some the most recognizable and popular brands in the world: Johnnie Walker, Smirnoff, Tanqueray and Guinness... and we're only just getting started. But we're more than just our brands. We are committed to becoming the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products company in the world. Being passionate about our consumers and customers sits both at the heart of our values and how we will deliver our performance ambition in every country where Diageo operates.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR? We seek to attract the best talent people and inspire them to deliver their best work ever. Passionate, engaged and talented individuals of all kinds who are hungry to do great work—and have a lot of fun while doing it. It's all about finding people who can inspire a team, drive brand and category growth, and make our brands famous.

Sr. Brand Manager – Scotch Portfolio (Black&White, Buchanans, Old Parr, White Horse)

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven marketing leader to manage Scotch Portfolio brands with a proven track record in strategic thinking, consumer insights, brand development, and effective execution. This role requires someone who can navigate the full marketing process—from concept to execution — helping us define the future of White Horse, within portfolio, communication and cultural strategy development and execution while demonstrating strong business acumen, leadership, and a deep understanding of the competitive landscape.

The ideal candidate will be action-oriented, adaptable, and skilled at managing multiple workstreams (ATL/BTL plans) simultaneously, ensuring attention to detail and excellence in every consumer interaction. We are looking for a balance of brand activation expertise, business insight, and leadership abilities to collaborate effectively with internal and external partners across a fast-paced and competitive category. Impact, boldness, and creativity are essential to success.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Lead Scotch Portfolio strategy, including the development of a 5-year vision and annual business plans.

  2. White Horse brand management – lead development and implementation of White Horse brand communication, events and cultural strategy based on consumer insights, cultural trends, and market dynamics.

  3. Manage the annual planning process, ensuring alignment with growth drivers, market share, financial goals, and the delivery of brand and communication plans.

  4. Collaborate with creative agencies, global and local brand teams, Customer Marketing, Market Insights, and Innovation to design and execute comprehensive brand plans across Media, Culture, Activation, On-Trade, Off-Trade, and Events.

  5. Lead and mentor a brand team, fostering talent development and encouraging a collaborative, high-performance culture.

To succeed in this role, the candidate must have:

  1. A minimum of 8 years of proven experience in brand management.

  2. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to thrive in dynamic and complex environments.

  3. Strong execution capabilities with the ability to prioritize and manage competing demands effectively.

  4. Strong drive, delivery and determination. Proven ability to think strategically and drive long-term business growth across a complex and broad portfolio.

  5. High levels of accountability and autonomy.

  6. Creative flair and consumer back obsession, reflected in outstanding creative work.

  7. Having the ability to fast adapt to changes and make all actions tangible measuring impact and results with clear learnings.

  8. Written and verbal communication skills in English.

Flexible Working Statement:

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

Diversity statement:

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this. We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you’ll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more.

Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world.

O Gerente de Operações é responsável por gerir um grupo de contas de segmentos diversos, sendo o guardião e multiplicador dos processos, modus operandi e qualidade de entrega da Soul Trade Marketing.   4. Power BI - Nível Intermediário/Avançado (desejável)

  6. Habilitação Regularizada
  7. Disponibilidade para viagens
  8. Carro próprio e habilitação ativa

  2. Comunicação Eficaz
  3. Inteligência Emocional
  4. Engajamento
  5. Foco no Resultado
  6. Orientação para Servir

Você quer trabalhar em uma empresa que cuida da jornada de desenvolvimento de cada colaborador e agrega valor à sua carreira? Então, venha para o trade! Trabalhe na Soul!

A Soul Trade, uma agência diferente, que já nasceu com uma alma questionadora que observa as mudanças da sociedade e do mercado e, através disso, atua de forma humanizada, impactando positivamente a vida dos seus colaboradores, clientes, consumidores e shoppers.

Nosso propósito é ser uma agência especialista em planejamento, execução e controle de experiências que fortalecem o vínculo das marcas com seus consumidores e assim, geram vendas e alavancam o resultado dos nossos projetos e, para ser quem somos, trabalhamos a partir de valores que consideramos essenciais:

Proximidade, respeito, determinação, relações, criatividade.

Você se identifica com nosso propósito e compartilha dos nossos valores? Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Conheça nossas vagas, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte de um dos nossos cases de sucesso!

Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We also care about our communities and want to help make them better places to live every day.

Who are we looking for? Our people are truly the heart of our company, and we’re on a journey together. It’s about more than a job. title: Gerente de Negócios Agro | Cascavel
description:
Job description

Você está na página da maior e mais completa cooperativa de crédito independente do país, e a maior com atuação preferencial na área da saúde.

Somos mais de 500 colaboradores que juntos trabalham pelo propósito de melhorar a vida financeira das pessoas, para proporcionar maior segurança, tranquilidade e bem-estar.

Como reconhecimento do ambiente que construímos e das oportunidades que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, a Sisprime foi selecionada como uma das LinkedIn Top Companies 2024 , um ranking que destaca as melhores empresas para quem deseja crescer profissionalmente no país. Ficamos na 7ª posição entre empresas com menos de 5.000 colaboradores , sendo a 1ª colocada no Paraná e a única cooperativa no ranking.

Recebemos também o Prêmio EXAME em Gestão de Pessoas , ficando entre as três organizações destaques do segmento, uma distinção que valoriza as práticas exemplares de recursos humanos e o compromisso com o desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.

Além disso, fomos eleitos novamente como um dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2024 (FIA/ESTADÃO), pelo terceiro ano consecutivo, reforçando nosso compromisso em manter um ambiente positivo e acolhedor.

Com essas conquistas, a Sisprime agora acumula mais de 10 premiações voltadas ao ambiente de trabalho, reafirmando nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento e o bem-estar de todos que fazem parte da nossa cooperativa!

Em nossos 27 anos de trajetória, acumulamos muitos marcos e recordes. Crescemos em abrangência, expansão das agências físicas, ativos administrados, número de cooperados e sobras distribuídas.

Atualmente, contamos com números que impressionam, como:

  • R$ 9 bilhões em recursos administrados;
  • R$ 1,3 bilhão em patrimônio líquido;
  • Mais de 52 mil cooperados;
  • 48 agências nos estados de Paraná, São Paulo, Santa Catarina, Minas Gerais e Mato Grosso do Sul.

Na Sisprime do Brasil, os cooperados não são apenas números, são histórias que se unem à nossa. São eles quem dão sentido ao nosso propósito de melhorar a vida financeira das pessoas, para proporcionar maior segurança, tranquilidade e bem-estar.

Para nós, crescer com solidez significa inovar e manter o foco naquilo que é mais importante: as pessoas. Os resultados que alcançamos só são possíveis graças ao trabalho e a dedicação de cada um dos nossos colaboradores. Temos como princípios o respeito, diálogo, oportunidades de crescimento e profissionalismo.

Confira as vagas disponíveis e venha trabalhar com a gente!


Main responsibilities

  1. Visitar cooperados no setor Agro, conforme cronograma com as agências e suas necessidades, com o objetivo de alavancar negócios para cooperativa;
  2. Identificar e buscar novos cooperados em potencial, como produtores rurais, cooperativas e revendas com o objetivo de oferecer soluções que melhor atendam as suas necessidades;
  3. Negociar taxas, condições de pagamento e prazos de entrega, estabelecendo melhores condições para os cooperados visando sempre a satisfação e a rentabilidade da operação;
  4. Elaborar propostas comerciais, montando parecer de crédito e enviando para aprovação, com o objetivo de melhores negócios para cooperativa;
  5. Analisar o mercado e concorrência, acompanhando as tendências de preços de comodities e identificando oportunidades e ameaças que possam impactar negativamente nas operações, para junto com a Diretoria montar as estratégias comerciais;
  6. Participar de feiras e eventos relacionados ao setor do Agro, colocando a cooperativa em evidência, com o objetivo de oferecer produtos e serviços competitivos com o mercado Agro;
  7. Estabelecer conexões de rede com outros profissionais do setor e identificar novas oportunidades de negócios;
  8. Treinar e capacitar a área comercial (Gerentes de Negócios) sobre as modalidades do crédito rural, prazo das operações, taxa, culturas e suas volatilidade, garantindo o uso adequado das modalidades e enquadramento das operações, de acordo com as atividades rurais de cada cooperado;
  9. Participar de reuniões com a Diretoria, para apresentar a evolução dos negócios relacionados ao Agro.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Experiência como Gerente de carteiras Agro em instituições financeiras;
  • Experiência na prospecção e gestão de carteiras;
  • Certificação CPA 10 ou CPA 20;
  • Vivência comercial;
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre análise de crédito;
  • Conhecimento geral de economia e mercado financeiro;
  • Conhecimento em Matemática Financeira;

Additional information

Benefícios:

  • Vale-alimentação e refeição;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Bolsa auxílio-educação;
  • Uniforme;
  • Vale-transporte.

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Responsável pela gestão das fabricas de FFO, afim de garantir a eficiência e produtividade do processo, garantindo o bom funcionamento das fabricas e melhor capacidade de processamento, manutenção, qualidade e capacidade produtiva de cada operação fabril;

Líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul, a Minerva Foods é mais do que uma empresa global – somos uma comunidade de profissionais com o propósito de seguir "criando conexões entre pessoas, alimentos e natureza". title: IT Product Delivery Manager
description:
It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Essa posição é para atuar em modelo híbrido em Contagem, MG.

Who will you be working with?

Our best-in-class IT team is looking for a Product Delivery Manager to join Wabtec and build out the next generation of our platforms. They will be a key leader for our Information Technology (IT) function focused on driving and communicating product strategy, leading cross-functional projects and programs related to core technologies like VMware, OpenShift, Red Hat Linux, and Oracle.

How will you make a difference?

The ideal candidate is a hands-on project manager, has significant experience in developing software solutions and IT third-party technical relationship management. The successful candidate must have strong firsthand expertise in software development and understanding complex enterprise systems. They must be at ease working in an Agile/hybrid-agile environment with little supervision. They should embody a passion for continuous improvement and data-driven efforts.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Technical program and product management experience, specifically in the software engineering space.
  • Experience in documenting product requirements for both IT and product applications in a medium to large-scale organization.
  • Proven experience working in both Agile and Waterfall project management environments.
  • Practical skills in product requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation for infrastructure-related hardware and software products.
  • Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Excellent project management and program delivery skills, including experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to present to and influence leadership.
  • Proficient in data analysis and using insights to drive continuous improvement of HR technology offerings.
  • PMP, Scrum, or other relevant certifications.
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Exposure to IT technology implementation and change management.
  • Strong technical background and understanding of IT infrastructure architectures in the Public Cloud, VMware and physical on-premises.
  • Excellent Communication and Presentation skills.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Manage complex, multi-workstream projects and programs to drive the implementation and adoption of new IT technologies.
    • Coordinate efforts for the complete project and product lifecycle, from conception to delivery and ongoing maintenance.
    • Translate product needs into quality requirements for stakeholders and project teams.
    • Facilitate meetings and workshops with stakeholders to review requirements, deliverables, issues, and risks.
    • Adherence to IT PMO standards and requirements.
    • Budget management, delivering projects on time, on budget, with quality.
  • Own the product roadmap and strategy for key IT platforms and services.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver impactful solutions.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from IT leadership to business partners.
  • Leverage data and user insights to make informed decisions and continuously improve the IT offerings.
  • Define solution boundaries and scope of deliverables.
  • Specification and documentation of functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Assist technically in training and coaching professional and technical staff.
  • Accountable for the DevOps lifecycle of managed applications, including handover of sustain structure to third parties or other support teams.

Who are we?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Customer Success Manager (LATAM)
description:
Matific is a leading global EdTech provider, delivering an adaptive online learning platform for primary school mathematics. With our product being utilised by millions of students, teachers and parents in 100+ countries we are helping educate the youth and bring equality to education. With over $50M USD invested and a global team of over 200+ employees, we are committed to achieving our goals. We’ve also picked up a number of awards including numerous CODiEs, Academics’ Choice and Edtech Digest to name a few.

THE ROLE

Our Customer Success team is responsible for ongoing relationships with our schools and customers across LATAM, driving up customer satisfaction and maximizing retention. We are looking for a highly motivated individual with an interest in education to join our dynamic team, with a strong passion for looking after and nurturing customers.

The role will be responsible for delivering training, providing proactive support and value add services, driving engagement with our platform, working closely with the sales team on smooth onboarding and transition, upselling of additional student licences and most importantly renewals. This is a fantastic opportunity for that ambitious person who wants their career to grow within a growing company.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Onboarding: Lead the onboarding process for new schools, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into the platform.
  2. Training and Support: Proactively provide training and support to our local customers both onsite and online. Occasionally schedule webinars and conference calls with customers' time zones.
  3. Customer Engagement: Foster strong relationships with school users by providing regular check-ins and value-added services and identifying opportunities to increase platform engagement and retention. Deliver account reviews to ensure customers are achieving their desired outcomes.
  4. Upsell: Proactively monitor license usage and upsell additional licences being used.
  5. Renewals: Ensure maximum renewals yearly both by school number and value.
  6. Marketing Collaboration: Work with the marketing team to identify success stories, case studies, and customer testimonials that can be used in promotional materials.
  7. Think outside the box on retention ideas.
  8. Platform Knowledge: Stay up to date with all features and developments on the Matific platform, ensuring you are well-informed to provide the best possible customer support.
  9. Generate invoices: for renewals and upsell licence invoices.
  10. Usage Monitoring and Insights: Track and analyze platform usage data, offering insights and recommendations to school users and internal teams to improve platform utilization.

Requirements

  1. At least 3 years of client services experience.
  2. Ability to work in a hybrid environment, balancing remote and on-site responsibilities.
  3. Strong consultative approach with a positive and solution-oriented mindset.
  4. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; bilingual proficiency is a plus.
  5. High energy, a collaborative team player, and a results-driven attitude with a passion for success.
  6. Education sector experience is a bonus but not essential.

description:
Canonical es una empresa de software global, editora de Ubuntu y soluciones empresariales de código abierto para la nube, desarrolladores, IoT e IA. Ubuntu es la distribución de Linux de más rápido crecimiento y se posiciona como el sistema operativo número uno en la nube.

En colaboración con Google, Amazon, IBM y Microsoft, Canonical ayuda a las empresas a ser más ágiles, productivas y a adoptar nuevas tecnologías rápidamente. Ejemplos de éxito incluyen IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma de desarrollo preferida.

El papel de un representante de desarrollo de ventas en Canonical

Canonical es rentable y está en crecimiento. Consideramos que nuestro equipo de desarrollo de ventas es la mejor academia de ventas de tecnología del mercado, seleccionando candidatos excepcionales y ambiciosos para unirse a nuestro equipo. Disfrutarás este rol si eres organizado, persistente, carismático y trabajador, con interés en la tecnología y sus implicaciones comerciales. Colaborarás con un equipo regional de ventas y marketing, con el objetivo principal de identificar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestras líneas de productos y promover la marca Canonical en diversas industrias y geografías.

Cómo será tu día

  • Gestionar consultas entrantes de clientes vía email, teléfono y chat.
  • Ejecutar campañas de ventas y marketing salientes.
  • Viajar a eventos y conferencias, presentar en stands y promover oportunidades comerciales en persona.
  • Colaborar con múltiples equipos y stakeholders de alto nivel para impulsar resultados.
  • Trabajar con marketing en campañas específicas.
  • Investigar información sobre clientes potenciales.
  • Generar un pipeline de ventas de varios millones.
  • Identificar tendencias y oportunidades del mercado.
  • Ayudar a definir procesos y políticas del equipo.
  • Servir de enlace con clientes nuevos y existentes, organizando reuniones y mapeando cuentas para nuevas oportunidades.
  • Crear, mantener y fomentar clientes potenciales en oportunidades globales.

Lo que buscamos en ti

  • Excelentes resultados académicos en escuela y universidad.
  • Pasión por negocios y tecnología.
  • Compromiso con aprendizaje y mejora continua: curioso, flexible, analítico.
  • Resolución creativa de problemas y trabajo en equipo.
  • Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
  • Orientación a resultados y espíritu de superación.
  • Persistencia y perseverancia.

Qué te ofrecemos

El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, algunos roles incluyen beneficios adicionales, bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca la equidad global.

Ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo:

  • Presupuesto de USD 2000 anuales para desarrollo personal.
  • Revisión salarial anual.
  • Programas de reconocimiento y recompensas.
  • Vacaciones anuales y licencia parental.
  • Programa de asistencia al empleado.
  • Oportunidades de viaje para conocer colegas en eventos o sprints.
  • Priority Pass y mejoras en viajes para eventos corporativos de larga distancia.

Canonical fomenta la igualdad de oportunidades y un ambiente de trabajo diverso e inclusivo, valorando todas las identidades y antecedentes.

Join to apply for the ENFERMEIRO - SAMU role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

As Unidade de Pronto Atendimento são estabelecimentos de saúde de complexidade intermediária entre as Unidades Básicas de Saúde/Estratégia Saúde da Família (UBS/ESF) e a Rede Hospitalar, compondo uma rede organizada de atenção às urgências, conforme as diretrizes da Política Nacional de Atenção às Urgências. Funcionam 24 horas, oferecendo atendimento médico de urgência e emergência para adultos e crianças, com possibilidade de inclusão de outras especialidades médicas, como Ortopedia, conforme necessidade regional.

O atendimento é realizado através do Acolhimento com Classificação de Risco, que prioriza o tempo de atendimento conforme a gravidade do paciente. O serviço oferece leitos de observação, exames laboratoriais de urgência, exames de imagem, procedimentos como suturas, inalação, administração de medicamentos e encaminhamento ao hospital de referência, se necessário, após estabilização.

  11. Controlar o estoque de materiais, mantendo níveis mínimos;
  12. Preencher registros específicos da assistência de enfermagem;
  13. Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos;
  14. Prestar assistência a pacientes graves desde a admissão e acompanhá-los em remoções;
  15. Organizar o armazenamento de receituários controlados;
  16. Supervisionar procedimentos assistenciais, focando em segurança e redução de riscos de infecção;
  17. Acompanhar a escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;
  18. Cumprir normas de biossegurança;
  19. Participar de ações de parceria com instituições de ensino;
  20. Observar aspectos éticos na assistência, especialmente na participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e residentes;
  21. Executar outras atividades pertinentes ao cargo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  1. Ensino Superior completo em Enfermagem, com registro ativo no COREN;

title: Senior Environmental Consultant
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

Posting Date: 9 May 2025

Location: Sao Paulo, BR

Contract Type: Permanent

Division: Sustainability and Business Innovation

Level of experience: Senior

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Environmental Consultant to join its office in São Paulo within the Sustainability and Business Innovation Division .

Mission

The Senior Environmental Consultant focuses on leading and overseeing the assessment and mitigation of environmental risks associated with energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects. They deliver permitting-related services, conduct environmental studies, environmental monitoring and modeling, compliance assessments, due diligence, and audits to evaluate compliance with Italian and European regulations or Project Financing standards. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

  1. Lead Environmental Impact Assessment Studies:
    • Lead and oversee comprehensive environmental impact assessments for energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects, analyzing factors such as air quality, water resources, and biodiversity.
    • Provide strategic guidance and technical expertise in conducting environmental studies to facilitate permitting and authorization processes, identifying potential risks and mitigation measures.
  2. Environmental and Social Due Diligences, Studies, and Audits:
    • Lead due diligence assessments to evaluate environmental and social risks associated with projects, ensuring thorough analysis and identification of potential impacts.
    • Oversee audits to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, social standards, and financial requirements, providing recommendations for improvement.
  3. Analysis of Pollutant Dispersion and Deposition:
    • Utilize advanced modeling techniques to simulate pollutant dispersion from energy facilities, evaluating potential impacts on air quality, water bodies, and soil.
    • Lead assessments of deposition patterns and concentrations of pollutants to estimate environmental effects and risks, providing expert recommendations for mitigation.
  4. Develop Tailored Mitigation Strategies:
    • Lead the development of tailored mitigation strategies to address environmental and social risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
    • Collaborate closely with project teams to integrate mitigation measures into project plans and financing agreements, providing technical guidance and oversight.
  5. Collaboration with Interdisciplinary Teams:
    • Work closely with engineers, economists, legal advisors, and other professionals to analyze data and assess project feasibility, providing expert input on environmental considerations throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment.
  6. Prepare Comprehensive Reports:
    • Lead the compilation and analysis of environmental data to prepare detailed reports for stakeholders, including investors, financiers, and regulatory authorities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with reporting standards.
    • Effectively communicate findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to support Project Financing activities and client decision-making processes.
  7. Support Proposal Preparation and Client Liaison:
    • Assist in preparing project proposals and financing documents, including environmental sections and risk assessments, providing expert input and guidance.
    • Engage proactively with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements and address environmental concerns during project development and financing negotiations, building strong client relationships.
  8. International Travel and Site Visits:
    • Travel internationally as required to conduct site visits and assess environmental, health, safety, and social aspects of projects, providing expert oversight and guidance.
    • Review and monitor environmental documentation, compliance measures, and project implementation on-site, ensuring adherence to environmental standards and requirements.
  9. Project Management Support:
    • Provide leadership and support for project management tasks, including monitoring budgets, schedules, and milestones, ensuring timely delivery of environmental deliverables and compliance with financing requirements.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of successfully leading comprehensive environmental impact assessments for energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects.
  • Proven experience (8+ years) in environmental assessment methodologies and compliance with project financing environmental and social standards.
  • Expertise in utilizing advanced modeling techniques for pollutant dispersion and deposition analysis.
  • In-depth understanding and application of IFC Performance standards, ADB/EBRD/Equator Principles, or other international lenders’ standards in infrastructure and energy sectors.
  • Ability to perform air quality and noise modeling, and use Windpro for shadow flicker, noise, and visual impact assessments.
  • Experience in developing mitigation strategies to address environmental and social risks, ensuring compliance with regulations and industry standards.
  • Strong collaboration skills with interdisciplinary teams, providing expert environmental input throughout project lifecycles.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Science or Engineering
  • Master’s Degree in Environmental Engineering

Additional Information

  • All positions are available to people with disabilities (PwD / PCD).
  • Address the way - Have a big picture of different situations and reinterpret them in a perspective way.
  • Build network - Forge trust relationships across departments and outside the organization.
  • Client intimacy - Embrace internal and external client needs, expectations, and requirements to ensure satisfaction.
  • Earn trust - Take everyone's opinion into account and remain open to diversity.
  • Make effective decisions - Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources, and constraints.
  • Manage emotions - Recognize one's and others' emotions and regulate reactions.
  • Pioneer change - Embrace change actively and benefit from new circumstances.
  • Promote sustainable development - Keep promises and serve as a role model.
  • Think forward - Use experiences to create future action plans.

With over 5,800 employees and 200 offices in 70 countries, RINA provides certification, marine classification, testing, inspection, training, and engineering consultancy services. We aim to ensure the sustainability of projects from concept to completion, covering technical, environmental, safety, and sometimes economic and financial aspects.

At RINA, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities and do not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or agencies. Please, no phone calls or emails.

Atender e servir os clientes, demonstrar produtos e efetuar vendas apresentando promoções. Cooperar com conferências, armazenagens e organização de mercadorias. Arrumar os balcões no layout exigido, primando pela aparência (beleza e fartura), limpeza e facilidade de transitar no setor. Verificar diariamente a validade de todos os produtos que fazem parte da seção, retirar de exposição os produtos vencidos e com aparência inadequada. Aqui na Shô, acreditamos que cada membro de nossa equipe é fundamental para o nosso sucesso, e que diversidade de perspectivas e vivências são essenciais para movimentar nosso negócio e impulsionar o nosso propósito de mudar o mundo para melhor. Qual será a sua missão

Estamos buscando uma (a) Product Manager que será responsável por manter, desenvolver e gerenciar um produto para nossos Vendedores. Para isso, deverá converter necessidades do negócio, do usuários e de regulações em requisitos de desenvolvimento. Seu produto principal será um sistema que os vendedores que atuam no Fulfillment (Estoque na Shopee) irão usar para operar nessa modalidade.

Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Ajudar ativamente a nossa equipe de produtos a funcionar da forma mais eficaz possível, criando e mantendo ferramentas de produtos, tais como painéis de controle para acompanhar a adoção de funcionalidades;
  • Colaborar estreitamente com a equipe de gestão de produtos para compreender o roteiro, os objetivos e as prioridades dos produtos;
  • Estruturar e analisar dados para ajudar a equipa de produto a tomar decisões mais bem informadas;
  • Monitorizar os principais indicadores de desempenho (KPI), como o tempo de colocação no mercado, a qualidade do produto e a satisfação do cliente;
  • Atuar como uma ponte entre as partes interessadas técnicas e não técnicas, traduzindo o jargão técnico em termos compreensíveis e vice-versa;
  • Desenvolver e monitorizar processos para simplificar as práticas de gestão de produtos, tais como quadros para a etapa de discovery e também para a de delivery;
  • Gerir os bugs e os erros comunicados pelos clientes, incluindo a definição de prioridades, a investigação, a coordenação da resolução e a comunicação eficaz com as equipes competentes;
  • Manter um registo exaustivo e atualizado dos problemas comunicados, do seu status, do progresso da resolução e da análise pós-resolução;
  • Efetuar uma análise exaustiva das causas profundas dos erros e problemas para identificar os problemas subjacentes e contribuir para a prevenção de ocorrências futuras.

O que você precisa para assumir o desafio

  • Formação completa em cursos de engenharia ou na área de negócios ou tecnologia;
  • Experiência nas atividades descritas acima ou em atividades correlatas;
  • Atuação em empresas de marketplace/e-commerce é um diferencial;
  • Habilidades analíticas (conhecimento em SQL é um diferencial);
  • Inglês avançado (será testado durante o processo de seleção).

  • Bônus anual discricionário, atrelado à performance.
